purpose: Fixed cross-mission engineering sample for catalogue recovery and residual transit screening, not a population survey.
selection: Retain all four Milestone 2 anchors and add two named archive targets per mission before inspecting their photometry. Added TESS targets are Pi Mensae and TOI-700, two bright or well-studied multi-planet systems with confirmed transits beyond the common 0.5–5 day search. Added Kepler targets are TrES-2 and Kepler-17, short-period controls with distinct stellar variability. Added K2 targets are K2-18 and K2-3, systems with known transits outside or near the search window. Use the earliest eligible TESS pipeline sector by filename, the earliest standard Kepler long-cadence product at least 400000 bytes, and the earliest K2 long-cadence campaign. Keep all selected targets, including failures. No replacement or selection by search outcome.
